packageRules.description: Only manage the Fleet image; mysql, redis, etc. in the same directory are left alone

Fleet stable (vX.Y.Z) and RC (rc-minor-fleet-vX.Y.Z / rc-patch-fleet-vX.Y.Z) tags. RCs count as prereleases of the same version, so the newest of either is proposed, and a stable release supersedes its RC. RC tags are rebuilt in place, so digests are pinned to catch re-pushes.
